Item Class: Abyss Jewels
Rarity: Magic
Shocking Ghastly Eye Jewel of Acclimatisation
--------
Abyss
--------
Requirements:
Level: 46
--------
Item Level: 83
--------
{ Prefix Modifier "Shocking" (Tier: 3) — Damage, Elemental, Lightning, Minion }
Minions deal 1(1-4) to 45(44-50) additional Lightning Damage
{ Suffix Modifier "of Acclimatisation" (Tier: 1) — Elemental, Resistance, Minion }
Minions have +10(6-10)% to all Elemental Resistances
--------
Place into an Abyssal Socket on an Item or into an allocated Jewel Socket on the Passive Skill Tree. Right click to remove from the Socket.
